_comment: config_mismatch_template.json — Copy this to config.json and fill in your app's details.
Description: Brief description of what the app claims to do (e.g., 'a flashlight app')
_comment_ManifestPath: Path to the APK file. If set, aapt auto-extracts ManifestPermissions and ExportedComponents. Leave empty to supply those lists manually below.
_comment_ManifestPermissions: Declared Android permissions from AndroidManifest.xml. Auto-populated if ManifestPath is set. Otherwise fill manually.
_comment_ExportedComponents: Components with android:exported=true. These can be triggered externally (mismatch vector). Auto-populated from APK if ManifestPath is set.
_comment_analysis: The run_mismatch_detection.sh script populates TotalMethod and Tag automatically from the AndroLog-instrumented APK. You do not need to set them manually.
